name: Chaotic Noise Topography (Crazy Noise)
description: A superconducting X-ray scanner designed to illuminate the deepest microscopic grain structures (Sensor Noise/PRNU). Every single physical camera sensor on earth possesses a cryptographic 'fingerprint' composed of unique silicon flaws, coating the image in a fine, uniform optical noise floor. When a fraudster slices an object from Image A into Image B (or an AI synthesizes a missing section), the lacerated zone will bleed a 'Crazy Noise' pattern—either violently conflicting with the host sensor's underlying architecture or disturbingly smoothed out entirely.
algorithm: PRNU Fingerprint Extraction & High-Frequency Variance Matching
mechanism: The algorithm mercilessly slaughters the visual layers of the image—stripping away faces, buildings, and colors entirely—retaining only the raw static electrical noise matrix. It then actively sweeps the grid, calculating noise variance topographies. If a region violently erupts with an anomalous, foreign noise cluster (brought in from a spliced photo) or is morbidly smooth and sterile (due to an AI hallucination forgetting to synthesize organic optical grain), the system detonates an emergency forensic alert.
parameters: Non-linear Extraction: Wavelet Denoising Filter, Defect Detection: Photo-Response Non-Uniformity (PRNU), Variance Map: Gaussian Estimation Threshold
accuracy: Exceptionally High (85-92%) - One of the most cold-blooded, mathematically irrefutable executioners in the digital forensics arsenal for unmasking alien spliced imagery.
source: Lukas (2006) / Silicon Sensor Flaw Identification Networks
useCase: Operates as an inescapable cryptographic lie-detector, stripping naked any region of an image forcibly injected from an external source by analyzing the impossibly hard-to-fake physical atomic footprint of the camera sensor.

references.title: Lukas, J., Fridrich, J., & Goljan, M. (2006). Digital camera identification from sensor pattern noise. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Functionally impossible to evade unless the malicious actor possesses military-grade forensic capabilities to actively harvest, reverse-engineer, and synthesize the specific PRNU fingerprint back over the fake spliced region.
• Devastating against Generative AI: AI models often synthesize environments that are unnaturally, surgically clean. 'Crazy Noise' instantly red-flags these as completely devoid of the necessary physical semiconductor flaws.
limitations:
• Rendered completely blind, shattered, and functionally useless if the image has been aggressively scrubbed via social media compression algorithms (WhatsApp/Facebook), which actively crush and destroy 90% of sub-pixel sensor noise characteristics.
• Plummets in effectiveness in heavily underexposed, solid black regions where the camera artificially amplifies gross ISO gain noise, creating a muddy quagmire that disorients fine PRNU calculations.
